map.这个工具怎么用？: How do I use this tool?
map.在对应输入框填入参数，结果区会即时给出计算结果。: Enter the parameters in the fields; the result area updates immediately.
map.按公元纪年排序浏览中外重大历史事件，支持主题、世纪与关键词筛选；公元前事件以负数: Browse major Chinese and world events in chronological order with theme, century and keyword filters. BCE events sort as negative years, so their order stays correct. CSV export follows the current filters instead of re-reading the whole theme.
map.事件以“年份＋标题＋分类＋简述”的结构保存，渲染时按年份升序排列。筛选支持世纪下: Events are stored as year, title, category and summary, then sorted by year. Filters include a century drop-down and keyword search; the 3rd century BCE means −300 to −201. Export shares the same filter function as the page, so the CSV contains exactly the events still on screen; an empty result triggers a warning instead of an empty file.
map.复习历史时按时间线梳理中外大事件，例如前 221 秦统一、1453 君士坦丁堡陷: Review major Chinese and world events on a timeline, such as Qin unification in 221 BCE or the fall of Constantinople in 1453.
map.做中西对比时选同一世纪，比较中国与世界的事件密度。: Choose the same century to compare event density in China and elsewhere.
map.备课时先筛出某个主题或关键词，再把当前结果导出为 CSV 继续编辑。: For lesson preparation, filter by theme or keyword and export the current result to CSV for further editing.
map.先选主题（如中国史、世界史或中西对照）。: Choose a theme (Chinese history, world history or China–world comparison).
map.选择世纪，或在关键词框输入“科举”“航海”等词缩小范围。: Choose a century, or enter a keyword such as “keju” (imperial examination) or “voyage” to narrow the list.
map.查看筛选后的时间线，确认事件数量与内容。: Review the filtered timeline and confirm the number and content of events.
map.点击导出，得到当前筛选结果的 CSV；如需完整主题，请先清空世纪与关键词。: Click Export to get a CSV of the current filtered result; clear the century and keyword first if you need the whole theme.
map.筛选“公元前 3 世纪”可得前 221 秦统一六国、前 202 楚汉相争结束等事: Filtering “3rd century BCE” returns events such as Qin’s unification in 221 BCE and the end of the Chu–Han contention in 202 BCE.
map.筛选“15 世纪”可得 1405 郑和下西洋始航、1453 奥斯曼灭拜占庭等。: Filtering “15th century” returns Zheng He’s first voyage in 1405 and the Ottoman conquest of Byzantium in 1453.
map.关键词输入“鸦片”后导出，CSV 只保留匹配事件；若无匹配，页面提示“未生成 C: Enter “opium” and export: the CSV keeps only matching events; if none match, the page warns that no CSV was generated.
map.事件清单是公开整理的常识性重大事件，并非学术全量。排序只解决先后关系，不代表因果: The event list is a public, general-knowledge selection, not an exhaustive academic dataset. Ordering shows sequence, not causation, and textbooks may date an event differently. Before exporting, confirm the century and keyword filters still match what you need.
map.内部用负数表示公元前，数值越小越早（−221 早于 −202），渲染时自动前置。: BCE years are stored as negative numbers, so a smaller value is earlier (−221 before −202) and is rendered first.
map.导出的 CSV 为什么和以前不一样？: Why is the exported CSV different from before?
map.旧版导出会忽略筛选、重新读取整个主题；现在导出与页面共用筛选函数，只包含当前世纪: The old export ignored filters and re-read the whole theme. Export now shares the page filter function and contains only events matching the current century and keyword.
map.筛选没有结果时还能导出吗？: Can I export when the filter returns nothing?
map.不能。工具会提示当前筛选无匹配事件，并拒绝生成只有表头的空文件，避免误以为数据丢: No. The tool reports that no events match and refuses to create a header-only file, so it is clear that data was not lost.
map.页面本身是只读浏览；可先按筛选导出 CSV，再在表格软件中增删与排版。: The page is read-only. Export the filtered CSV and edit it in spreadsheet software.
